name: Spicy Baked Chicken Wings with Italian Mushroom & Celery Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
12 sticks celery
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Juice half the lemons into a large bowl (reserve remaining lemons for the salad). Add oil and spices; whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp onion powder
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
¾ tsp thyme, dried

instructions.primary_message: Add chicken wings to the bowl with the marinade and toss to coat; divide between two baking sheet pans and spread out in a single layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.36 kg chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, juice remaining lemons into another large bowl. Add oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp white wine vinegar
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim celery and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces at an angle. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Thinly slice mushrooms and add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Chop chives into small pieces and add to the bowl.
Use a vegetable peeler to shave Parmesan; add to the bowl and gently toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!
